messages:
Sam (AE): Hey finance — quick deal desk: Xylon Dynamics (seed-stage robotics) asked for a special pilot pricing: 6mo pilot, usage-based billing, 50% off list for pilot period, PO with net60, and an option to convert to a 24mo committed plan at renewal. They say strong upside but cash-constrained. Need quick read — can we pilot at that discount? :thinking: 

Lena (Finance): Need a concise ask. What's list price, estimated pilot consumption, and what protections (prepay, cap, termination) are they offering? Net60 on a seed co is risky without credit.

Sam (AE): Details: list baseline = $240k/yr for the footprint they want (guesstimated). Pilot 6mo expected spend ~ $120k list -> requested 50% => $60k. They propose PO net60 and a capped monthly usage (SOW attached when we go to contract). Promise: case study + product feedback. Can offer 1yr conversion commitment if conversion happens within 3 months after pilot.

Tomas (Sales Ops): Quick numbers: ```List pilot: 120,000 Requested price: 60,000 Revenue if convert to 24mo commit at list: 240,000/yr```. Risk vectors: net60 PO from seed co -> likely collections burden. Also precedent: approving 50% sets a high discount for pilots. Recommend conditional pilot: prepaid credits covering at least 50% of pilot value or auto-bill card on file.

Lena (Finance): Agreed with Tomas. Options we can consider: 1) Approve pilot at 30% off with prepay 50% upfront; 2) Approve 50% off only if fully prepaid OR corporate guarantee from investor; 3) Deny and offer standard pilot credits (small free tier + usage at standard discount). Which do you want to pursue?

Sam (AE): Customer pushed on 50% because they're strapped. They offered a single PO from their parent holding company (not our usual buyer). Not comfortable asking for investor guarantee publicly. Would they accept 50% if we require auto-convert clause + 3mo prepaid credit + strict overage cap?

Diego (CTO): Technical flag: their integration will need a custom connector and SSO work estimated at ~2 engineer-weeks. That should be scoped and billed separately. Don't bake that into discount. Also production SLA for pilot not guaranteed unless dedicated infra is provisioned. We need to be explicit in contract.

Riley (Legal): Legal standpoint: net60 with seed PO — we need to confirm signatory authority and include invoice interest on late payments. Also need clear language on pilot scope, IP for integrations, and conversion terms. If prepaid, we can accept deeper discount. If they want mid-pilot termination, refund rules must be explicit.

Lena (Finance): For routing to Marin: propose approving a one-off 50% pilot discount only if ALL of the following are met: (a) 75% of pilot value prepaid to Redwood OR (b) corporate PO from an established parent with credit references; (c) billable SSO/custom connector scoped & billed separately; (d) auto-convert option to a minimum 12mo committed at no deeper than 25% discount; (e) Collections team approves PO/net60. If any missing, cap pilot discount at 30% with 50% prepay.

Sam (AE): I'll push for prepay 75% and auto-convert clause. Customer may push back — will try to get parent PO. If parent PO is provided, they'll want net60.

Marin (CFO): Quick note: I'm reluctant to approve 50% for pilots as a policy (bad precedent). I can approve a single 50% pilot exception if: 1) 75% prepaid, 2) CTO signoff on no ongoing infra obligations, 3) Legal approves the conversion language, and 4) Collections certifies acceptable credit risk. Otherwise, approve up to 30% with 50% prepay. Document these conditions in the deal desk form.

billing-bot: Invoice reminder: please attach expected billing cadence to deal desk ticket to avoid manual entries.

Tomas (Sales Ops): I'll update the deal desk entry with the proposed conditions and a renewal guardrail: require renewal price not to exceed the original list rate and forbid stacking pilot discounts on conversion.

Riley (Legal): Also add that any custom code or connector produced during pilot is triaged for ownership/licensing — we'll state vendor owns code unless otherwise agreed, and bill customization hourly.

Sam (AE): Thanks all. I'll try to secure 75% prepay or parent PO by EOD tomorrow. If we get it, I'll ping @Marin for sign-off on the 50% exception with the listed conditions. :raised_hands: 

Lena (Finance): Flagging as "needs CFO approval" in ticket. Tag me once PO or prepay confirmation exists.

Marin (CFO): Thanks. Please also include expected ARR if converted and link to account plan. I want to see 12–24mo expansion case before approving exceptions that deep.

Sam (AE): Copy. Adding expansion notes + investor info to the ticket.

Tomas (Sales Ops): Noted — will make sure auto-convert clause and billing rules are in the contract template.

Lena (Finance): Closing interim — in flight.
